uncertain.note: sic: the second letter is a clear V (two diagonals meeting at a point at the foot, open at the top), not an A, so the head reads PVRLEMENT; and the place name is TOLOSE without the H. Spaced capitals, closed up per §3.

uncertain.text: ſent (duquel eſt incertain, ſ'l eſt vif ou mort) auant que
uncertain.note: sic 'ſ'l': at 8x only a long ſ, an apostrophe and a single tall l stand before 'eſt'; there is no i (compare 'ſil' at blocks[2].lines[10], where two verticals and the i-dot are plainly visible). Apparently a dropped i for 'ſ'il'.

uncertain.text: Ille meos primus, qui me ſibi iunxit amores,
uncertain.note: the two Latin verses (Virgil, Aeneid IV) are set in italic and indented, one verse per printed line; transcribed as a paragraph block, not headings, because they are a quotation in running prose rather than a display title. 'iunxit' is set as 'iun xit' with a gap; closed up per §1.

uncertain.text: ans, ſil n'y a nouuelles certaines du mari, ne ſoit
uncertain.note: the mark after 'ans' is a small blotted wedge at the baseline read as a comma; it could be a period. 'ſil' is printed without an apostrophe (ſ + dotted i + l).

uncertain.text: ttouuées aſſez certaines (le mari eſtant mort à la guerre)
uncertain.note: sic 'ttouuées' for 'trouuées': at 6x the second sort is plainly a t with its crossbar, not an r.

uncertain.text: uoyoit certificatoire de ſa mort, ou luy. meſme en per
uncertain.note: a small round mark sits between 'luy' and 'meſme', slightly above the baseline; read as a period and spaced per §1. A further small speck follows 'per' at the baseline and is not transcribed; the line breaks 'per'/'ſonne' without a hyphen.

uncertain.text: ſoit contentée de faire attendre la femme, cinq ans {q}:
uncertain.note: the marker is an unmistakable italic q (bowl with descender), but no margin note is keyed q; the third note in the margin is keyed b, which is very probably this q set upside down. Recorded as printed on both sides.

uncertain.note: line breaks 'ſuf'/'firoit' without a hyphen (checked at 7x: only a faint speck follows the f).

uncertain.text: res & cõmunes, ne ſoit concluante, ne receuë {u}. Toutes.
uncertain.note: the line ends with a round baseline period after 'Toutes', the same size as the period after the marker, where the word-break sign should be; the word continues 'fois' on the next line. Transcribed as printed.

uncertain.note: the last sort of the page is broken and over-inked; the surviving stem and shoulder read as r, giving 'Ar' (the name continues on p008).
printed 'Premierede.' with no gap; separated per §1. The two lines give 'Premiere de. Corins. c. vij.'

the key letter is printed as an italic b (ascender with a loop at the foot, no descender). No body marker b exists on this page, and the body marker q has no note, so this is almost certainly the q sort set upside down. Key recorded as printed.

a small raised round mark follows 'Iuſtin', set at x-height and touching the n; read as a period, but it could be a superscript o. The line-break 'nouuel'/'les' carries no hyphen here (unlike the same phrase in note r).
the last letter is heavily inked; read as c ('vt lic.' = vt liceat, with 'mat. & auiæ.' following), but it could be read as e ('lie.').
printed 'v e' with a visible gap; closed up because the two sorts are the first syllable of 'velit', which continues on the next line.

this note keyed x has no matching {x} marker anywhere in the body: the markers run o p q r ſ t u y, with x skipped. The mark after the opening 'c' is small and raised (a period set high, or an apostrophe); read as a period.
a column of small round specks runs down the outer edge of the margin block, one beside most lines, clear of the type; taken as offset/show-through and not transcribed.
